Changelog
v0.24
Added
Restart button in the Options menu (right sidebar); asks for confirmation before restarting so you don't lose progress by accident
Right sidebar now includes a quest card that can pin an active quest and automatically falls back to the latest started active quest
Pregnancy now progresses in clear stages (Early, Showing, Late) with a progress bar in the sidebar and milestone notifications as the pregnancy advances
New pregnancy moments: morning sickness in the bathroom, noticing your changing body, and classmates reacting when you're visibly pregnant at school
Changed
Clothing Store, Pharmacy, Tech Store, and Wardrobe were updated with a cleaner, consistent look: simpler titles, unified button style, and consistent spacing
Inventory, Relations, and Quest Journal modals were redesigned with the new standard UI for a cleaner and more consistent look
Improved the phone Messages app with per-contact conversations, repeatable invitations, and new selfie-sending options, all with clearer quick actions and quest-aware behavior
Closed locations now show a visual overlay with "CLOSED" and when they will open (e.g. "Opens at: Evening"), making it easier to see which places are available at different times of day
Baby age in the sidebar now uses game time (60 days = 1 year); ages display as e.g. 2y 4m, 3m, or 5d
Pregnancy and babies sidebar panels were redesigned with clearer cards, progress bar, and layout; pregnancy test and sleep messages now vary by stage
Left sidebar (stats and info blocks) redesigned with a unified card style for a cleaner look
Right sidebar layout improved: BGM Volume uses the same card style as other blocks, the volume slider has a clearer thumb and matches the design, and spacing between sections was adjusted
Fixed
BGM volume now follows the volume you set with the sidebar slider and no longer resets to default when you refresh the page (F5)
Thomas's party quest now advances correctly when Thomas invites you on Friday
Version 0.24

  • Clothing Store, Pharmacy, Tech Store, and Wardrobe were updated with a cleaner, consistent look: simpler titles, unified button style, and consistent spacing
  • Inventory, Relations, and Quest Journal modals were redesigned with the new standard UI for a cleaner and more consistent look
  • Improved the phone Messages app with per-contact conversations, repeatable invitations, and new selfie-sending options, all with clearer quick actions and quest-aware behavior
  • Closed locations now show a visual overlay with "CLOSED" and when they will open (e.g. "Opens at: Evening"), making it easier to see which places are available at different times of day
  • Baby age in the sidebar now uses game time (60 days = 1 year); ages display as e.g. 2y 4m, 3m, or 5d
  • Pregnancy and babies sidebar panels were redesigned with clearer cards, progress bar, and layout; pregnancy test and sleep messages now vary by stage
  • Left sidebar (stats and info blocks) redesigned with a unified card style for a cleaner look
  • Right sidebar layout improved: BGM Volume uses the same card style as other blocks, the volume slider has a clearer thumb and matches the design, and spacing between sections was adjusted

Fixed

Changelog
v0.24
Added
Restart button in the Options menu (right sidebar); asks for confirmation before restarting so you don't lose progress by accident
Right sidebar now includes a quest card that can pin an active quest and automatically falls back to the latest started active quest
Pregnancy now progresses in clear stages (Early, Showing, Late) with a progress bar in the sidebar and milestone notifications as the pregnancy advances
New pregnancy moments: morning sickness in the bathroom, noticing your changing body, and classmates reacting when you're visibly pregnant at school
Changed
Clothing Store, Pharmacy, Tech Store, and Wardrobe were updated with a cleaner, consistent look: simpler titles, unified button style, and consistent spacing
Inventory, Relations, and Quest Journal modals were redesigned with the new standard UI for a cleaner and more consistent look
Improved the phone Messages app with per-contact conversations, repeatable invitations, and new selfie-sending options, all with clearer quick actions and quest-aware behavior
Closed locations now show a visual overlay with "CLOSED" and when they will open (e.g. "Opens at: Evening"), making it easier to see which places are available at different times of day
Baby age in the sidebar now uses game time (60 days = 1 year); ages display as e.g. 2y 4m, 3m, or 5d
Pregnancy and babies sidebar panels were redesigned with clearer cards, progress bar, and layout; pregnancy test and sleep messages now vary by stage
Left sidebar (stats and info blocks) redesigned with a unified card style for a cleaner look
Right sidebar layout improved: BGM Volume uses the same card style as other blocks, the volume slider has a clearer thumb and matches the design, and spacing between sections was adjusted
Fixed
BGM volume now follows the volume you set with the sidebar slider and no longer resets to default when you refresh the page (F5)
Thomas's party quest now advances correctly when Thomas invites you on Friday
Version 0.24

As you walk, a man starts following you, his gaze unnervingly intense. You pick up your pace, but he keeps up, closing the distance.


Thief
Hey! Hold it right there!
Victoria
Please, don't hurt me!
Thief
One more step and you'll regret it!
He lunges, grabbing your arms and roughly tying them together.


Victoria
What do you want from me?
Thief
You'll see. Now shut up and move!
Victoria
No, please! I don't want to go with you!
Thief
You don't have a choice!
He drags you towards a nondescript van, yanking open the door and shoving you inside.


Victoria
Where are you taking me? Please, just let me go!
Thief
Shut your mouth! You'll find out soon enough.
The van lurches forward, the drive agonizingly long. Finally, he pulls up to a secluded house and drags you inside.


Thief
I've seen you around. You never noticed me, though, did you?
Victoria
I don't even know you!

You will now.

I'll do anything, just please let me go home.
Thief
Anything, huh? Get down on your knees.
He unzips his pants, forcing his erection out. Terror freezes you in place as you reluctantly obey.


Thief
Yeah, that's it. Good girl. I've been waiting for this.
Victoria
Are you going to let me go after this? Please?
Thief
We'll see. Now, let's get this shirt off. I want a better look.
He rips your shirt off

The door slams shut behind you, the sound echoing in the sudden darkness. A figure emerges from the shadows, silent as a wraith. You can barely make out her face, but you feel the weight of her gaze - cold and sharp, like an ice pick. She moves with a predatory grace, circling you slowly before stopping inches away. Her voice is a low purr, barely audible above the thumping bass coming from somewhere deeper in the building.
Krait
Well, well. What brings a little lamb like you to this slaughterhouse?
Your throat tightens. You try to swallow, but your mouth's gone dry.
Victoria
Uh... someone said I could, you know... find some opportunities here.
Krait
Opportunities, huh? And who told you that little fairy tale?
Don't know his name

The door slams shut behind you, the sound echoing in the sudden darkness. A figure emerges from the shadows, silent as a wraith. Her voice is a low purr, barely audible above the thumping bass coming from somewhere deeper in the building.
Krait
Well, well. What brings a little lamb like you to this slaughterhouse?
Your throat tightens. You try to swallow, but your mouth's gone dry.
Victoria
Uh... someone said I could, you know... find some opportunities here.
Krait
Opportunities, huh? And who told you that little fairy tale?
Don't know his name

Changelog
v0.24
Added
Restart button in the Options menu (right sidebar); asks for confirmation before restarting so you don't lose progress by accident
Right sidebar now includes a quest card that can pin an active quest and automatically falls back to the latest started active quest
Pregnancy now progresses in clear stages (Early, Showing, Late) with a progress bar in the sidebar and milestone notifications as the pregnancy advances
New pregnancy moments: morning sickness in the bathroom, noticing your changing body, and classmates reacting when you're visibly pregnant at school
Changed
Clothing Store, Pharmacy, Tech Store, and Wardrobe were updated with a cleaner, consistent look: simpler titles, unified button style, and consistent spacing
Inventory, Relations, and Quest Journal modals were redesigned with the new standard UI for a cleaner and more consistent look
Improved the phone Messages app with per-contact conversations, repeatable invitations, and new selfie-sending options, all with clearer quick actions and quest-aware behavior
Closed locations now show a visual overlay with "CLOSED" and when they will open (e.g. "Opens at: Evening"), making it easier to see which places are available at different times of day
Baby age in the sidebar now uses game time (60 days = 1 year); ages display as e.g. 2y 4m, 3m, or 5d
Pregnancy and babies sidebar panels were redesigned with clearer cards, progress bar, and layout; pregnancy test and sleep messages now vary by stage
Left sidebar (stats and info blocks) redesigned with a unified card style for a cleaner look
Right sidebar layout improved: BGM Volume uses the same card style as other blocks, the volume slider has a clearer thumb and matches the design, and spacing between sections was adjusted
Fixed
BGM volume now follows the volume you set with the sidebar slider and no longer resets to default when you refresh the page (F5)
Thomas's party quest now advances correctly when Thomas invites you on Friday
Version 0.24

body_text:
A NEW MEMBER 🐍
The door slams shut behind you, the sound echoing in the sudden darkness. A figure emerges from the shadows, silent as a wraith. You can barely make out her face, but you feel the weight of her gaze - cold and sharp, like an ice pick. She moves with a predatory grace, circling you slowly before stopping inches away. Her voice is a low purr, barely audible above the thumping bass coming from somewhere deeper in the building.
Krait
Well, well. What brings a little lamb like you to this slaughterhouse?
Your throat tightens. You try to swallow, but your mouth's gone dry.
Victoria
Uh... someone said I could, you know... find some opportunities here.
Krait
Opportunities, huh? And who told you that little fairy tale?
Don't know his name

Fixed

A NEW MEMBER 🐍
The door slams shut behind you, the sound echoing in the sudden darkness. A figure emerges from the shadows, silent as a wraith. You can barely make out her face, but you feel the weight of her gaze - cold and sharp, like an ice pick. She moves with a predatory grace, circling you slowly before stopping inches away. Her voice is a low purr, barely audible above the thumping bass coming from somewhere deeper in the building.
Krait
Well, well. What brings a little lamb like you to this slaughterhouse?
Your throat tightens. You try to swallow, but your mouth's gone dry.
Victoria
Uh... someone said I could, you know... find some opportunities here.
Krait
Opportunities, huh? And who told you that little fairy tale?
Don't know his name

Well, I could maybe swing a 5% discount... but you'd have to do something for me.

What did you have in mind?

I'm a bit of a photographer, and you've got such a great look. How about letting me take a few pictures?

Just pictures? Sure, I can do that.
Strange
Excellent! Let's go in the back, where there's better lighting.

Now, don't be shy. I need to get a little closer, okay? Work it for the camera!

No problem, I'm ready for my close-up.


Strange
You know, I could probably do a 10% discount if you lost a few of these clothes...
I can't do this 😓
Back to the store 💻
